gimp.license: GPL-3.0-or-later; bundled upstream dependencies retain their own licenses
gimp.delivery: Download the unmodified installer from the official upstream service or a listed mirror (components.DOWNLOAD_SOURCES, family gimp), whichever measures faster, pinned by size and SHA-256; not bundled or repackaged by Aester
gimp.ownership: Independent GIMP installation, never adopted or removed by Aester

main_source.scope: Main GIMP source including build/windows/installer/gimp-setup.iss; not every bundled dependency source

gimp.existing_installation: Reuse compatible existing selection; never upgrade or overwrite existing installations or occupied targets
gimp.failure_boundary: No Aester active pointer change. Independently installed GIMP remains separately removable through Windows Settings.

skill.contents: Seven reviewed text files; no tutorial images, photographs, credentials or runtime
